capabilities: Export a note as a single self-contained HTML file
Embed images as data URIs and pre-render Mermaid diagrams to SVG
Preview the export in a popup before writing anything to disk
Bundle only the CSS snippets whose selectors match the exported note
Share the file via the native share sheet on iOS or save to a shared folder on Android
extras: Documents exactly which filesystem, clipboard, storage and snippet-reading capabilities it uses and why nothing is sent over the network; notes that some mobile viewers without JavaScript hide the theme toggle and copy buttons; installable via BRAT (DDEOK/Obsidian-Single-HTML-Export).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand a single note to someone as one offline HTML file without an asset folder or external dependencies.
summary: Exporter that turns a note into one self-contained HTML file with embedded images, CSS and pre-rendered Mermaid, for offline viewing and sharing.
